areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Linear park works with sustainable infrastructure, natural-heritage protection, solid-waste reduction and sustainability awareness.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: LED lighting across all interventions and housing, with later adoption of solar power in the park.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Includes solid-waste management and stormwater macrodrainage.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Soil conservation through erosion correction, riparian forest restoration, revegetation and recovery of degraded areas.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Landscape and permanent-preservation-strip recovery with a linear conservation unit, riparian vegetation and environmental education.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Social team prioritises training for jobs and income among low-income families affected by resettlement.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Linear park, leisure and sport areas, social spaces, cycle paths and better public lighting for the local low-income population.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Registry update identified vulnerable groups (women heads of household, elderly, informal traders); social work promotes income generation and access to inclusion policies.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Public-private partnerships may be signed for execution and for post-programme sustainability and maintenance.
